title: Seismic requirements.
officialText:
Anchored masonry veneer located in Seismic Design Category C or D shall conform to the
requirements of Section 6.2.2.10 of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5. Anchored masonry veneer located in Seismic Design Category
D shall also conform to the requirements of Section 6.2.2.10.3.3 of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5.
